rules.statement: The doctrine of laesio enormis does not apply to the sale of shares in incorporated companies.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is manifest that a share does not dovetail into the Roman or Roman-Dutch Law categorisation of movables and immovables. To the jurists of those sytems the concept of an incorporated company and the nature of a share with its peculiar attributes was something inconceivable. Hence, it will be incongruent to apply their doctrine of laesio enormis to a share which is neither a movable nor an immovable as conceived by them."
